rules.justification: sls_deviatoric: the port replicates the upstream operation order (D-008: coefficient-wise expressions in upstream operand order, halving-tree reductions for compile-time sizes, matrix product of the UD-029 dissipation through the Eigen coefficient-based order, glibc exp ported), so every recorded quantity is bit-identical in upstream-compat mode (UD-029/UD-063 reproduced); the corrected defaults are compared only where no defect applies.
rules.evidence: Measured in crates/akantu-solid/tests/material_fixtures_mat3.rs, debug build: 8,863 / 8,863 compat values (10 cases) and 7,664 / 7,664 corrected-default values bit-identical (dissipation and potential energy excluded: UD-029, UD-161); see docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md.
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
